critical.evidence: The proposed sudo entrypoint is bmarti44-owned mode 0775 under user-writable directories. Root begins interpreting it before authenticating its own bytes, so an in-place/path rewrite race can execute unreviewed trailing commands while internal Git checks see a restored clean tree.
critical.affected_gate: root installation authority and host integrity
critical.reproduction_instructions: In an isolated fixture, pause a multi-stage shell script after initial parsing, replace unread trailing commands, restore the visible source, and resume.
critical.proposed_acceptance_test: Use trusted root utilities to copy the exact reviewed installer into a root-owned non-writable temporary file, verify its reviewed SHA-256, and execute only that copy. A concurrent source mutation must either leave the exact staged bytes or fail before execution.

high.evidence: The controller validates its script-81 hash but discards preflight when choosing the root-approved candidate. Reservation succeeds when the actual clean executing HEAD differs but script 81 is unchanged.
high.affected_gate: frozen candidate authority, repository replacement, and unapproved descendants
high.reproduction_instructions: Return valid root approval for commit A and call _reserve_root_tombstone with preflight commit B; the current exact reserve response for A is accepted.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Require exact preflight harness commit equality with the root-approved candidate before reservation. Reject byte-identical-controller descendants, changed tracked receipts/freezes, alternate trees, stale HEAD, and repository replacement.

verified_candidate_11_progress: The helper no longer accepts a caller-selected candidate that differs from the root approval.
Executing controller bytes must match the root-approved controller hash.
Stale existing-marker retries fail closed before repository-lineage validation.
The root approval format, helper grammar, marker permanence, and fixed non-held-out smoke namespace passed bounded tests.

convergence.bounded_resolution: One controller equality check plus regression mutations, and a root-owned staged installer invocation authenticated by reviewed SHA-256.

remaining_independent_blocking_classes: BASE-R142-H4 / P1-BASE-IMPL-H3 matched cost and Pareto authority
claim_limit: Preinstall authority review only; no root installation, production reservation, held-out baseline, cost, NLL, fidelity, performance, or serving claim.
